source_caption_text:
Blueface and Chrisean Rock break up less than two weeks after getting engaged and have a violent altercation on livestream.

The volatile couple’s fairytale reunion is over. On Wednesday night (Oct 21), Blue was trying to do a confessional on livestream when Chrisean began telling him he was doing too much and to calm down. Despite Blue requesting Chrisean leave, she refused to vacate the studio. This sparked a more intense argument.

“Now, I’ma do too much on you,” Blueface snapped, getting in Chrisean’s face. “What are you gonna do about me doing too much?”

“That don’t scare me,” Chrisean responded.

Things got even more tense and eventually turned violent, with Blue standing up and pushing Chrisean while she screamed for him to calm down.

Chrisean later explained that she told Blue that their short-lived engagement is over.

“I’m separating myself completely. We cool as friends,” she said.

Blueface proposed to Chrisean in a club in Arizona on Oct. 12. He also recently got her name tattooed on his back.
